# Test fixture provenance

`nexoip-sample.stl` is a project-authored, synthetic pyramid created solely
for NexoIP 3D Viewer tests. It contains no third-party geometry or source
material and is distributed under the repository's root MIT license.

Fixtures below `format-matrix/` have their own pinned provenance, checksums,
and license inventory in `format-matrix/ATTRIBUTION.md` and
`format-matrix/SHA256SUMS.txt`.
